original.question: Guta reBillie riri muimba yekurara yemakareti rine 360 mafeeti-skwia. Kana urefu hweimba huri 3 yadi, muganhu weimba uri mumamwe mafeeti?
original.answer:
Urefu hweimba huri 3 yadi * (3 mafeeti / 1 yadi) = <<3*(3/1)=9>>9 mafeeti.
Upamhi hweimba huri 360 mafeeti-skwia / 9 mafeeti = <<360/9=40>>40 mafeeti.
Muganhu weimba uri 2(40+9) = 98 mafeeti
